This affects ALL data-dependent pages.

summary: Re-tested 15 assertions (12 assigned + 3 auth/layout re-verified). Results: 2 passed (auth/layout), 6 failed (all data-dependent pages blocked by recursive RLS policy 42P17), 6 blocked (prerequisites not met due to RLS), 1 skipped (not re-tested). Root cause remains: recursive RLS policy on horses table (42P17) blocks all PostgREST queries via anon key. Migration 034_fix_recursive_rls_policies.sql was never applied. No change from Round 1 results - the RLS fix migration was not applied.
